title: Making an arrow thicker takes one click, not three
goal: To change how thick an arrow is, you now have to find a row called Color, click a chevron to unfold it, and move a slider called Width. The word Color says nothing about line thickness, so the most common adjustment on a redline arrow is hidden. Put the thickness within reach the moment an arrow is selected.
notes: Found while fixing the arrow-endings walk on 2026-09-06. LayerParts.layerPartRows titles a non-switchable outline (arrow, line, highlight) "Color", and PartsInspector folds its PartWidthRow behind the chevron, so an arrow's width is two clicks deep. Options worth weighing: keep the width visible on the row for parts that have no switch, or bring a thickness row back into the Arrow section for arrows only. AnnotationInspector.visibleRows currently drops .thickness whenever shapePartsEnabled is on.
acceptance: Selecting an arrow shows a thickness control without unfolding anything
The control says what it changes in a word a person would use for an arrow
A rectangle keeps its Outline part working exactly as it does today
The arrow endings walk still finishes with status ok
